mn20:5.6: mohūpasaṃhitāpi → ‘tena bhikkhave -pe- mohūpasaṃhitopi’ paṭhoyaṃ marammachaṭṭhasaṅgītipiṭakapotthake na dissate.
mn20:7.2:
dante’bhidantamādhāya → dantehi dantamādhāya, – bahūsu. “dante+abhidantaṃ+ādhāyāti ṭīkāyaṃ padacchedo. dantehīti panettha karaṇattho vutto viya dissati” – machasaṃ.
 “dante’hidantamādhāyati heṭṭho dante uparidantaṃ ṭhapetvā” – aṭṭhakathā – siridhammārāma suddhi.
mn20:9.4:
dutiyo → “potthakāgatā pana uddānagāthā sabbatā visadisā aparisuddhā ca” – siri dhammārāma suddhi – adholipi.
“cūḷasīhanāda lomahaṃsa varo
mahācūḷadukkhakkhandhaanumānikasuttaṃ
khilapattha masadhupiṇḍika dvidhāvitakka
pañcanimittakathā puna vaggo” – machasaṃ, sīmu2
